Lena Morris: Quick design review for the playground: focusing on compact schema editor + run history behaviors. A few UX and a11y nits to decide.
Arjun Rao: SG, drop them here and we can triage.
Lena Morris: 1) Compact mode for the schema editor. Users want denser info when they9re debugging multiple functions. Proposal: collapse field descriptions by default, show a subtle chevron to expand. Tooltip "Show field details" on hover.
Priya Nair: +1. Also suggest a persistent "Compact" toggle in the top-right so power users can switch and it persists per workspace.
Noah Bennett: Implementation note: storing in local prefs vs org prefs? Local is faster for rollout. We can scope later.
Lena Morris: 2) Run history row actions: current primary action is "Open". That confused some folks. Propose primary "View invocation details" and a smaller kebab with "Re-run", "Copy payload".
Arjun Rao: Agree. Also show inline status pill (color + text) and on hover show duration + model used. Helps triage without opening the run.
Priya Nair: Accessibility: status color cannot be the only indicator. Add visually-hidden text like "Status: failed, 2 errors" and ensure contrast ratio >= 4.5 for pills.
Noah Bennett: Noted. We'll use accessible-color tokens. For iconography we can add aria-hidden icons and keep descriptive text for screen readers.
Lena Morris: 3) Live preview vs manual preview in schema editor. For large schemas live preview is noisy. Suggest live with debounce 800ms and a small banner when schema size > 2KB: "Large schema—preview paused. Click Resume Preview".
Arjun Rao: Nice. Also add a small badge that shows "Changes unsaved" when edits exist so users don't lose work.
Priya Nair: Screen reader behavior: when preview updates announce "Schema preview updated: 3 changes" via an aria-live polite region. But if paused, announce "Preview paused due to large schema".
Noah Bennett: We'll avoid automatic scroll to preview when updates occur to keep keyboard focus stable. Good call.
Lena Morris: 4) Microcopy: replace "Add function schema" with "Define tool inputs (JSON Schema)". Replace "Invoke" with "Run now" in the action menu.
Arjun Rao: Suggest small helper copy under the schema label: "Use JSON Schema draft-07. Examples available" with a link to examples panel.
Priya Nair: Examples panel must be reachable by keyboard and should announce "Examples panel opened". Each example should have an action "Insert into editor" and confirm via toast: "Example inserted".
Noah Bennett: UX edge: inserting example should not clobber unsaved changes. Show a confirm modal if editor dirty: "Replace current edits with example?" with "Cancel" and "Insert".
Lena Morris: 5) Keyboard shortcuts: quick open run (\/ to focus search), "r" to re-run selected run, "e" to expand schema details. Need an ARIA cheat-sheet in the help menu.
Arjun Rao: Confirming no conflicts with browser shortcuts. We can use focused-list handlers and require the list to be focused for single-key shortcuts.
Priya Nair: Also add focus-visible outlines for the compact mode; some of our compressed elements lost obvious focus.
Lena Morris: 6) Diff UI: when schema changes show a compact inline diff with changed keys highlighted. For long diffs show a "Show full JSON diff" link. Screen readers: announce count of changed keys and provide a link "Read changes as text" that opens a linearized accessible summary.
Noah Bennett: We'll use a semantic diff library and expose a text-summary endpoint for screen readers if needed.
Deploy Bot: deploy.preview: playground-compact-schema-controls pushed to staging at 2026-03-23T15:05:00Z :white_check_mark:
Arjun Rao: I'll open a PR with the toggle, badges, and run-row changes. Will include exact copy strings.
Priya Nair: I'll audit the staging build with VoiceOver + NVDA and share a short checklist.
Lena Morris: Thanks team. Please tag me on the PR for copy review. :thumbsup:
